.github/workflows/deploy.yml:6:9  info  EG012 ci-secret-undocumented  workflows use variable DEPLOY_ENABLED, but no template or schema documents it
  variable: DEPLOY_ENABLED
  why: Whoever sets up a fork, a new environment or a new repository has to discover DEPLOY_ENABLED by reading workflow files; a missing one usually shows up as a failed deploy.
  fix: Document it: add `DEPLOY_ENABLED=` to .env.example with a comment such as `# CI: set in GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions (Variables tab)`, or declare it under `variables:` in .envguard.yaml.
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG012-ci-secret-undocumented.md

  variable: DEPLOY_KEY
  why: Whoever sets up a fork, a new environment or a new repository has to discover DEPLOY_KEY by reading workflow files; a missing one usually shows up as a failed deploy.
  fix: Document it: add `DEPLOY_KEY=` to .env.example with a comment such as `# CI: set in GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions (Secrets tab)`, or declare it under `variables:` in .envguard.yaml.
  related: .github/workflows/deploy.yml:16:24
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG012-ci-secret-undocumented.md
